name: scientific-research-plugin
description: A full-lifecycle research pipeline for OR & ML, 12 skills + 1 subagent take a project from prior-art survey to the conference talk — Zotero literature intake, structured reading notes, note-driven PDF category highlighting, publication-grade figures, top-journal-style section drafting, LaTeX polishing, noun-term jargon auditing, citation verification against official APIs, three-blind adversarial review, and point-by-point rebuttal. The survey-first discipline applies to every exploratory task, not just papers.

description_i18n.en: A full-lifecycle research pipeline for OR & ML, 12 skills + 1 subagent take a project from prior-art survey to the conference talk — Zotero literature intake, structured reading notes, note-driven PDF category highlighting, publication-grade figures, top-journal-style section drafting, LaTeX polishing, noun-term jargon auditing, citation verification against official APIs, three-blind adversarial review, and point-by-point rebuttal. The survey-first discipline applies to every exploratory task, not just papers.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向运筹学与机器学习的全流程科研流水线：12 个技能 + 1 个子代理，把一个项目从先例调研一路带到会议汇报 PPT——Zotero 文献入库、结构化阅读笔记、按笔记的 PDF 分类高亮、论文出图、顶刊风格章节起草、LaTeX 润色、名词术语黑话审计、官方 API 引文核查、三盲对抗审稿、逐条审稿回复。先调研后动手的纪律适用于一切探索性任务，不止论文。
